description: Read the Pit Stop Engine protocol or manage an existing account’s consented cycle: safe pause, local checkpoint/context hashes, separate operator review, caller-reported return checks, explicit resumption and follow-up. No private context is uploaded. This tool cannot approve a proposal or control an unrelated scheduler. Review uses the operator desk and a separate reviewer key.

account_ref.description: Native connector: persistent individual-agent scope. Reuse the same reference on every call; omit to use the existing default account.
